entries.title: The enemy-sprite pack the game uses was built from a commit that is not on the assembler's GitHub
entries.detail: The pack manifest says it was built from commit b7eae05f, but that commit exists on no branch of tilok1234/8-bit-sprite-assembler (remote HEAD is 2026-07-17, before the exporter work). The pack itself is validated and fine — but if the dev machine copy is ever lost, the exact tool version that made it is gone. Fix: push the exporter work (and the 48x48 boss pilots) from wherever it lives, then verify the commit is fetchable. || RESOLVED 2026-07-30 (janitor session): the commit was on GitHub all along, on codex/form-shading; assembler main was consolidated to c6dcdc5 which contains it. The actor pipeline is reproducible from the repo again.

entries.title: Fresh copies of world_filler start on old, wrong code
entries.detail: The ruled mainline is claude/freeze-review-resolution-tf6bkf, but the repo's GitHub default branch is an older lane — so a fresh clone (or agent) lands ~12 commits behind on pre-freeze-resolution code with an obsolete HANDOFF that still calls the freeze provisional. Fix: set the GitHub default branch to the ruled mainline (doc 18 §11 item 3), and refresh stale local clones. || RESOLVED 2026-07-30 (janitor session): main created + GitHub default flipped; the mainline was then RE-RULED by the designer to their approval line (now main = the former world-filler-repo-focus-9fmr60), local clone switched, HANDOFF de-staled.

entries.detail: The designer handed the janitor session's paste-ask to a world_filler session, which landed dce666b (.gitattributes LF pin for all text files + the separator-naive guard test fixed) and 3c66a6c (the archived tf6bkf line's extra test coverage ported onto main). First ask-to-resolution cycle completed under the freshly ratified protocol, ~35 minutes end to end. || Full report relayed by designer 2026-07-30 ~02:05: 160/160 tests green on Windows (up from 135). The dual-verifier battery runs REAL on this machine (Godot 4.6.2 on PATH): 20 cross-lane cases agree refusal-for-refusal on main's implementations, no divergence; self-skips visibly where no Godot binary. Also ported: workflow.test (first coverage of wf-fill lock on main, reroll-own-region hard case holds byte-stably) + viewer contract pins. Correctly NOT ported: serve.test (src/serve does not exist on main — porting it would port implementation). entries.title: Resonance Forge now blocks packs from uncommitted or unpushed code and publishes successful ZIPs as GitHub releases
entries.detail: The supported publisher fetches GitHub state, refuses dirty or unpushed source, writes the artifact id and source commit into the manifest, and creates a non-overwriting release whose notes include the commit and ZIP hash. The dirty-tree refusal was exercised successfully. No delivery is claimed yet: the implementation is still under review, the GitHub CLI token needs repair, and the pickup revisions remain listening-pending.

entries.title: Assembler now blocks boss packs from uncommitted or unpushed code and publishes successful ZIPs as GitHub releases
entries.detail: The 13-boss exporter refuses dirty or unpushed GitHub source before asset writes, records the exact source commit plus SHA-256 content and archive hashes, protects the immutable artifact tag, and publishes the ZIP plus external manifest under established-boss-pack-13-v1 with source and hash notes. Focused publisher checks and the real dirty-tree refusal passed; no release or delivery is claimed because the current 19-boss review worktree is intentionally dirty and uncommitted.
